name: TC-03: Verify Issue Types Filtering Functionality on the Roadmap Page -> Uncheck "Feature"

steps.name: Before Hooks
Fixture "context"
Create context
Fixture "page"
Create page
Fixture "roadmapPage"
Pre-condition: User is on the Roadmap page and default filters are applied
Navigate to "/projects/redmine/roadmap"
Check locator('label').filter({ hasText: 'Defect' }).locator('input[type="checkbox"]')
Check locator('label').filter({ hasText: 'Feature' }).locator('input[type="checkbox"]')
Check locator('label').filter({ hasText: 'Patch' }).locator('input[type="checkbox"]')
Click locator('input[value="Apply"]').first()
Wait for load state "load"
Step 1: Uncheck the "Feature" checkbox and click the "Apply" button
Uncheck locator('label').filter({ hasText: 'Feature' }).locator('input[type="checkbox"]')
Click locator('input[value="Apply"]').first()
Wait for load state "load"
Expected Result 1: The tasks with the corresponding "Feature" are no longer displayed in the "Related issues" list
Evaluate locator('table.related-issues td.subject a')
ERROR: Tasks with type "Feature" are still displayed in the list!
Expected Result 2: The tasks with other checked trackers remain visible
Evaluate locator('table.related-issues td.subject a')
